title: Destin mayor holds monthly 'fireside chat' - NewsBreak
text: DESTIN, Fla. ( WKRG ) – Residents gathered Wednesday to hear from Destin Mayor Bobby Wagner at his monthly fireside chat. One of the topics on the agenda, the My Safe Florida Home Program, is a state program to help homeowners protect their houses against hurricanes. “The state of Florida is now allowing and helping people, basically with a grant, to allow people to offset the cost of what it would take to improve their home so that insurance can stay flat or maybe come down, their home resiliency goes up and it’s just a win win across the board,” Mayor Bobby Wagner said. They also talked about city projects and the proposed budget for fiscal year 2026. “Really, this is a critical time for the citizens’ engagement and to make sure that we’re on par with what they want to see completed. Whether it’s a park, some amenities, a beach, all these things,” Wagner said. They also discussed the preliminary vision for the future Marler Bridge. The Florida Department of Transportation is looking to replace the existing four-lane bridge with a six-lane bridge. “This is the time to be proactive as government, as local government to make sure that the state’s build is exactly what the citizens and the quality of life that we want to see in our area,” Wagner said. Mayor Bobby Wagner hosts his fireside chat on the first Wednesday of every month at Beachworx. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to WKRG News 5.
